name: hero-clothes-back
prompt: This is Luna, the real woman under the city AI's version of her: about 27, tall and slim, with adult proportions and long legs, standing exactly as in the first reference, at the same size in the frame. Her face pale and tired, with plain lips and no make-up; her dull ash-blonde hair in its plain, fairly thin high ponytail. Seen from behind, her back to the viewer: the back of her head with the ponytail hanging down the middle of her back, the thin dark strap of her goggle across the back of her head. Her face is not seen. She has taken off her long coat and is in what she wears under it: a plain fitted black top with long sleeves, tucked into her trousers and covering her stomach completely, a black belt, dark charcoal-grey baggy cargo trousers with a pocket on the thigh, tucked into scuffed black lace-up combat boots with thick soles. The same flat-shaded style: two or three flat tones per surface, crisp edges, no texture.
concierge: Luna as the city AI shows her: the same beautiful woman, standing exactly as in the first reference, her curvy figure with a full bust, her glossy black hair in a high ponytail with hot-pink and teal streaks. Seen from behind, her back to the viewer: her glossy black ponytail with hot-pink and teal streaks, tied with a pink band, hanging down her back. Her face is not seen; only the edge of the ice-blue visor's light shows at the side of her head. Her long red coat taken off: a fitted black top with long sleeves and a low neckline, tucked into slim black trousers fitted to her legs, not baggy and with no pockets, covering her stomach completely, going into sleek black ankle boots with slender high heels. Bold make-up and glossy red lips. The same flat-shaded style.
framing: One full-length figure seen straight from behind, her back to the viewer, standing in a relaxed neutral pose: arms hanging at her sides, slightly away from the body, hands empty, legs straight and a little apart. Feet at the bottom of the frame. Even, soft lighting with no cast shadows and no rim light. Transparent background, the whole figure in frame with a little space around it, no ground, no text, no border.
